descriptionChirho: A piece of rock as a physical object used for building, throwing, setting up as a memorial, paving, or as raw material; covers all inflectional forms (singular, plural, construct, with prepositions and pronominal suffixes) referring to literal stones.
A stone used as a standard weight on a balance or scale for measuring in trade (אַבְנֵי מִשְׁקָל); translated as 'weight' or 'weights' rather than 'stone.'
A precious or semi-precious stone used as a jewel or ornamental gem (אֶבֶן יְקָרָה, אַבְנֵי־חֵן), distinct from ordinary stone by its value and decorative function.
A metaphorical title for God as the Rock or Stone of Israel (אֶבֶן יִשְׂרָאֵל, Gen 49:24), emphasizing divine strength, stability, and covenant faithfulness.
